name: Haus Tyrol
beschreibung: The Haus Tyrol welcomes holidaymakers to a sunny, peaceful hillside setting in Nesselwängle within Tyrol's Tannheimer Tal, situated at approximately 1,100 metres above sea level. Decorated in a welcoming alpine style, the guest rooms feature contemporary en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing unobstructed views of the striking Rotflüh and Gimpel rock needles. Following outdoor pursuits, the on-site wellness area featuring a Finnish sauna and steam bath offers soothing relaxation. A wholesome breakfast buffet laden with regional delicacies is served each morning. Scenic walking trails leading up to rustic alpine chalets and Lake Haldensee start right outside. In winter, cross-country ski tracks pass close by and local ski slopes cater superbly to families.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy alpine hotel in a sunny panoramic setting in Nesselwängle in the Tannheimer Tal with mountain-view rooms and wellness.
